gotchas: This node is the union of the whole color package plus the two gradient presets, which live in the theme package because presets consume a derived scheme. A change to GradientPresets.kt makes this node stale, not the theme node.
OKLCH has no alpha channel: the conversion out drops it and the conversion in takes alpha as a separate argument, so round-tripping a translucent color loses its alpha.
The ink-picking helper returns pure black or pure white only, choosing whichever contrasts higher; it is not a tinted ink.
Conversion back to BasisColor clamps each channel into sRGB, so out-of-gamut OKLCH values silently lose chroma.
All categorical colors generated for one mode share a single chroma, the maximum across the seed hues floored at the tuning minimum, so seeds of differing chroma do not stay distinct on that axis.
Categorical indices past the end of the seed hue list do not wrap: they rotate the last seed by the golden angle, so a short seed list silently extends rather than repeating.
The gradient value type is a plain description of stops and direction, not a Compose brush; the main library is expected to map it.
The brand gradient preset bakes in a 30 degree hue rotation and a 0.75 chroma factor as literals in the preset rather than as tuning fields.

invariants.rule: The color files never import the theme package; the dependency runs the other way
